skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration with nmap scripts sshv1, ssh2-enum-algos, ssh-hostkey

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service is discovered but directory listing incomplete
skill_cards.then_action: Launch gobuster for forced enumeration with wordlist and follow redirects

skill_cards.then_action: Check sudo rights, SUID binaries, and readable /etc/passwd for escalation candidates
